landing.h1a: Collegium — a legion of swarm agents,
landing.sub: Collegium turns a pile of repositories into a crew of agents you can actually supervise. Describe the work once — the rack plans it, swarms it, and opens the PR. Every destructive step waits for your green light.
landing.busSub: Every run rides exactly one blueprint. Each is a small, honest contract — what goes in, what comes out, what never happens without you.
landing.bpAsk: point questions in, cited answers out — from your own docs and code.
landing.bpPlan: a goal in, an ordered execution graph out. Nothing runs until you approve it.
landing.bpDebug: a failing test or a stack trace in; a root cause out, with evidence.
landing.bpDevelopment: tickets to diffs — scoped edits, tests, and a PR carrying its evidence package.
landing.bpSwarm: the full rack on one goal: parallel lanes, merged by the lead.
landing.bpGoal: multi-step campaigns that keep their own ledger of done and remaining.
landing.opsH2: Built for the operator, not the demo.
landing.opsSub: Agents are easy to start and hard to trust. Every surface below exists so you can watch, verify, and override — without reading a log firehose.
landing.ftApprovals: Every destructive tool call lands in a queue with its exact payload. Allow or deny — the agent never argues.
landing.ftSwarm: Parallel agents on one goal — each streams its own lane. The lead merges; you watch the water, not the logs.
landing.ftPatrol: While you sleep, the rack reads your repos and queues ranked proposals — impact × confidence, no noise.
landing.ftKnowledge: An org memory with scope LEDs. Answers cite the corpus they were distilled from.
landing.ftCosts: Every run carries its price. The ledger keeps per-repo and per-mode bars honest.
landing.ftIdeas: Half-formed ideas get a thread, not a ticket. The team argues, an agent counsel synthesizes consensus and open questions — then you promote the winner straight to a plan.
landing.ftTeam: One rack, many engineers — per-operator identity, approvals routed to a named owner, costs attributed per teammate.
landing.ftCloud: Deploys on your VM or VPC with docker compose — the team reaches it in a browser, your code and keys never leave.
landing.finalSub: the rack is warm — your repos are already waiting.
landing.footerTag: a legion of swarm agents, moving as one
